description: Angular component for a multi-input widget in the Thingsboard platform, managing dynamic form controls, data sources, validation, and data persistence.

classes.name: MultipleInputWidgetComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing a dynamic multi-input form widget with data source integration, validation, and save/discard functionality.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the widget, sets up data sources, form, and resize observer.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources like resize observer and subscriptions.

methods.name: initializeConfig
methods.description: Sets default widget settings and titles.

methods.name: updateDatasources
methods.description: Processes data sources, initializes data keys, and handles backward compatibility.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Constructs the reactive form controls based on data keys.

methods.name: updateWidgetData
methods.description: Updates form controls with latest data from data sources.

methods.name: getKeyValue
methods.description: Retrieves value using custom getValue function if defined.

methods.name: updateColumns
methods.description: Adjusts layout columns based on container width.

methods.name: onDataUpdated
methods.description: Refreshes widget data when data source updates.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Handles layout resize events.

methods.name: getGroupTitle
methods.description: Generates group title label for data source.

methods.name: getErrorMessageText
methods.description: Provides validation error messages.

methods.name: radioButtonSelectedColor
methods.description: Returns CSS style for radio button color.

methods.name: getTranslatedErrorText
methods.description: Translates error messages.

methods.name: getCustomTranslationText
methods.description: Returns custom translated text.

methods.name: visibleKeys
methods.description: Filters visible data keys.

methods.name: datePickerType
methods.description: Returns date picker type based on key value type.

methods.name: focusInputElement
methods.description: Selects input element on focus.

methods.name: inputChanged
methods.description: Handles input change, triggers save if needed.

methods.name: colorChanged
methods.description: Updates color value and triggers save.

methods.name: saveForm
methods.description: Saves current form data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists data to backend, handles success/error notifications.

methods.name: setKeyValue
methods.description: Applies custom setValue function if defined.

methods.name: discardAll
methods.description: Resets form to initial values.

methods.name: openEditJSONDialog
methods.description: Opens dialog for editing JSON data key.

methods.name: invalid
methods.description: Checks if form has validation errors.
